image_urls.description: Abstract colorful iridescent sphere (AI Agent Avatar)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Use a monospace font like JetBrains Mono for all headings, numbers, and stats to give an IDE vibe. ONLY use Inter for body paragraphs and small UI labels to maintain the developer aesthetic.
Ensure the dashboard background is strictly #0B0F19 (deep dark) with sidebar slightly darker (#070A10).

Implement the 4 Metric Cards precisely: Security (Green), UI/UX (Blue), Backend (Pink), Tech Debt (Yellow). Use these colors sparingly as text highlights, icons, or subtle borders. DO NOT flood cards with these colors.
Build a real React Router navigation in the sidebar (Dashboard, Proyectos, Scaffolding, Roadmap, Centro IA, Conexiones MCP, Ajustes).
Implement the AI chat section, active tasks list, and commit history as separate bento-grid widgets on the dashboard.
Never use generic Shadcn components without customizing them to fit the dark/neon futuristic theme. Add subtle borders (border-white/5) and remove heavy shadows.
Include a prominent 'AI Suggestion Banner' with Accept/Reject buttons at the top of the dashboard content area.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and actionable widgets to ensure testability.
